issues.issue: Lines 0-6 (Salaries, Payroll taxes, Insurance, Utilities, Repairs and maintenance, Gas and oil, Professional fees and dues) are object lines that mix General and Street Fund money. All of them went to general government, although part is streets/highways (e.g. Street Fund 6,950 salaries, 3,305 repairs). This is defensible because the page prints only one Total line per object, and the lines are marked review.
State taxes paid from the keno fund (likely keno/lottery tax) are an object, not a function. 'economic development' (community betterment) is a judgment call; general government is also possible.

Sanitation (refuse) is listed under 'utilities' in the disbursement category rules (water, sewer, electric, gas, refuse). health/welfare is defensible but doubtful. The same call is made in detail[14].
The object of the General Fund capital outlay is not stated. 'equipment purchases' is a guess; the line is already marked review.
